Foundation Identifies Over 23,000 Phishing Email Attempts in Passport Wallet Security Incident Passport hardware wallet maker Foundation said it has identified more than 23,000 phishing email attempts, including 19,057 messages delivered through Mailgun and 1,503 sent via Google Workspace. The number of affected users remains unknown. The investigation found that personal information from historical WooCommerce orders remained in legacy database tables despite appearing redacted in the admin dashboard. Customer data from orders placed through Shopify since May may also have been exposed. Foundation said it has revoked affected email credentials and taken compromised legacy services offline. There is no evidence that Passport devices or their private keys were compromised. The phishing emails attempted to trick users into revealing their wallet recovery phrases. — link

Sixpence to run points campaign on Robinhood Chain with 10,000 USDG rewards Sixpence, an onchain money market for tokenized U.S. stocks, will run a points campaign on Robinhood Chain from October 26 at 00:00 to November 23 at 00:00 (UTC), with a total reward pool of 10,000 USDG, split into two periods of 5,000 USDG each. Sixpence allows users to borrow stablecoins against tokenized U.S. stocks such as AAPL, TSLA, and NVDA, or deposit stock tokens into a Vault to earn interest. The project raised $5 million in seed funding from investors including a16z CSX. — link

Highlight Clip: Chris Dixon: Why Expand a16z Crypto into a16z Frontier? Chris Dixon: Why Expand a16z Crypto into a16z Frontier? On October 23, 2026, a16z Managing Partner Chris Dixon said the expansion of a16z Crypto into a16z Frontier reflects the increasingly blurred boundaries between crypto, fintech, Wall Street, and mainstream technology. Stablecoins have become a standard tool for fintech companies, while asset tokenization is growing rapidly. The team will explore frontier areas that remain underserved by existing investment efforts, continuing its approach of identifying investment opportunities in the second-order effects of technological advances. — link

Grayscale Says Zcash's 20% Developer Funding Has Fueled a Decade of Innovation Grayscale, a leading digital asset manager, highlighted Zcash's (ZEC) continued innovation ahead of its 10th anniversary on October 28, attributing part of its progress to the allocation of 20% of block rewards to developer funding. The privacy-focused cryptocurrency has evolved through multiple shielded pools, from Sprout and Sapling to Orchard and the 2026 Ironwood upgrade, which introduced quantum-recoverable addresses and formal verification to address security vulnerabilities. — link
